name: ecom Tab-Ex 02 DZ1
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 02 DZ1 is a flameproof (Ex d) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 9. It has been discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 2GD Ex db ia op is IIC T5 Gb / II 2GD Ex tb ia op is IIIC T100°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current (issue 2, 2021-01-12), checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued (ecom archive).

iecex.marking: Ex db ia op is IIC T5 Gb / Ex tb ia op is IIIC T100°C Db

certification.northAmerica: CSA: Class I, II, Division 1, Groups A-G T5; Class I, Zone 1 AEx db ia op is IIC T5 Gb; Zone 21 AEx tb ia op is IIIC T100°C Db; Ta −20 °C to +50 °C
certification.protection: Flameproof enclosure (Ex db) with an intrinsically safe circuit (Ex ia)

safety.conditions: ATEX Sira 19 ATEX 1017X X conditions: use only in areas with a low risk of mechanical impact; no electrical connections in the hazardous area (charging/data only via the dedicated charger or dock in the non-hazardous area); the WWAN model may be opened for SIM access only in the non-hazardous area; other models must not be opened by the user; if either enclosure is opened or damaged, remove from the explosive atmosphere and have it repaired by the OEM.

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android (version not printed; latest firmware Android 9 per earlier research)

specs.storage: 16 GB, microSD up to 256 GB (cannot be fitted or replaced after delivery)
